title: Spanish Style Arroz con Kale
description: A hearty Spanish-inspired rice dish packed with nutritious kale. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat the lard or oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and sauté until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the chopped kale and cook until wilted, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the cooked arroz, chicken broth, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer, then reduce the heat to low and cover.
Cook for 15-20 minutes or until the liquid has been absorbed and the arroz is tender.
Stir in the diced tomato and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
Let the dish rest for 5 minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld.
